none.name: Blank
none.hint: Start empty and build sections yourself.

ort_main.name: ORT main test
ort_main.hint: Five timed sections (Math I, Math II, analogies, reading, grammar), forward-only, one attempt.

ort_subject.name: ORT subject test
ort_subject.hint: One timed section for a chosen subject.

navigation.free: Free: all sections open, no section time limits
navigation.section_forward_only: Section by section: no going back

create.title: New assessment
create.subject: Subject
create.languagesHint: Every question must exist in each selected language. ORT exams are normally one language each.

list.title: Assessments
list.deleteBody: It is hidden from students. Attempts already made are kept. You can restore it from the trash.

lobby.forwardOnly: Sections go in order. When you finish a section you cannot return to it.
lobby.freeNav: You can move between questions freely.
lobby.cannotStart: You cannot start this assessment right now.

reasons.not_open_yet: This assessment has not opened yet.
reasons.not_open: This assessment has not opened yet.
reasons.attempts_exhausted: You have used all your attempts.

builder.title: Edit: {title}
builder.readOnly: This course is concluded, so the assessment is read-only.
builder.noSections: No sections yet. Add the first one.

settings.title: Title
settings.languagesHint: Publishing requires every question to be available in each selected language.
settings.timeLimitHint: Leave empty to use the sum of the section limits, or no limit.
settings.showCorrect: Show correct answers and explanations with the results

section.deleteBody: Section "{name}" will be removed. A section must be empty to be deleted.
section.timeLimitHint: Empty means the section is not timed.
section.timeLimitFreeHint: Section time limits are not allowed with free navigation.
section.allowedTypesHint: Leave all unchecked to allow every type.
section.rulesLocked: The question types of an ORT section are fixed.
section.empty: No questions in this section yet.

add.title: Add to section
add.translationHint: A question also covers its translations: in other languages of this assessment the linked translation is used.
add.passageHint: The passage and all of its questions are added as one block that stays together.

pick.hint: Each student gets this many random questions from the bank that match the filter. The pool is fixed when you publish.
pick.tagsHint: Up to 5 tags, separated by commas.

publish.valid: No problems found. Ready to publish.
publish.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last published version.
publish.confirmTitle: Students have already started this assessment
publish.confirmBody: {inProgress} students are taking it and {submitted} have submitted. They keep the version they started; new attempts use the new version. Publish anyway?

issues.unresolved_language: A question has no version in one of the assessment languages.
issues.question_deleted: A question was deleted from the bank.
issues.type_not_allowed: A question type is not allowed in its section.
issues.passage_mismatch: Questions of a passage belong to different passages.
issues.pick_pool_too_small: A random pick asks for more questions than the bank has.
issues.section_limit_in_free_navigation: Section time limits cannot be used with free navigation.
issues.section_limits_exceed_total: Section time limits add up to more than the total time limit.
issues.after_close_needs_until: Showing results after closing needs an "available until" date.
issues.too_many_items: The assessment has too many questions.
issues.languages_not_in_course: A language of the assessment is not a course language.

errors.draft_conflict: Someone else changed this assessment. It was reloaded; apply your change again.
errors.languages_not_in_course: Assessment languages must be languages of the course.
errors.too_many_items: Too many questions in this assessment.
errors.section_not_empty: Remove the questions from the section first.
errors.order_mismatch: The list changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.preset_rule_locked: This rule is fixed for ORT sections.
errors.item_type_not_allowed: This question type is not allowed in this section.
errors.item_language_mismatch: The question has no version in the assessment languages.
errors.item_duplicate: This question is already in the assessment.
errors.passage_mismatch: Questions of a passage must belong to the same passage.
errors.publish_invalid: The assessment cannot be published yet. See the problems below.
errors.confirm_required: Students have already started this assessment. Confirm to publish.
errors.attempts_in_progress: Students are taking this assessment right now.
errors.language_not_available: This language is not available for the assessment.
errors.section_not_current: This is not the current section.
errors.use_submit: This was the last section. Submit the attempt.
errors.invalid_response: The answer is not valid for this question.
errors.attempt_not_submitted: The attempt is not submitted yet.
